args.title: Fix error toast announcements and dismissal timing
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Change error toasts to use an assertive live region for immediate announcement and prevent automatic dismissal so errors stay until dismissed, per accessibility requirements.

label: bug
file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The file src/components/Toast.tsx manages toast notifications including their live region and dismissal timing. To fix the issue, error toasts should use an assertive aria-live region to be announced immediately and they should not auto-dismiss like success toasts, so users can read error messages until they manually dismiss them. This improves accessibility by ensuring error messages are promptly and clearly conveyed.
